paper.title_en: Constraints on the inflationary vacuum and reheating era from NANOGrav
paper.abstract_en: NANOGrav and various pulsar timing array experiments recently reported compelling evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB). Such a background may originate from several astrophysical or cosmological sources. Assuming an inflationary origin, we use the latest NANOGrav 15-year dataset to constrain inflationary parameters, including the tensor spectral index ($n_t$), tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r$), and explore the implications for reheating through constraints on the reheating equation of state ($ω_{\text{re}}$) and reheating temperature ($T_{\text{re}}$). We find a preference for an extremely blue-tilted tensor spectrum and a non-instantaneous reheating epoch. Despite no concrete evidence on primordial vacua, inflationary vacuum is commonly assumed to be the Bunch-Davies vacuum. In this work, we study modifications to the GW spectrum arising from a two-parameter Bogoliubov family of non-Bunch-Davies vacua. Within this framework, we find that NANOGrav observations favour a subclass of non-Bunch-Davies vacuum, known as the alpha-vacuum. In addition, our analysis demonstrates that the observations strikingly narrow the range of the parameter $α$ that characterizes the vacua. Our analysis indicates that the NANOGrav data can accommodate both matter- and radiation-like reheating scenarios for the standard Bunch-Davies vacuum case. However, within the non-Bunch-Davies framework considered here, a non-matter-like reheating is preferred because matter-like reheating requires relatively large $α$, violating both the NANOGrav upper bound and the backreaction constraint. We further show that a frequency-dependent parametrization of $α$ beyond a threshold frequency can yield a minimal solution that alleviates the blue-tilted issue. Finally, we highlight the possibility of testing such frequency dependence of $α$ through future GW experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文利用最新NANOGrav数据对暴胀真空和再加热时期进行约束，特别研究了非Bunch-Davies真空的影响，与PTA主题高度相关且具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 来自NANOGrav对暴胀真空和再加热时期的约束
decision.abstract_zh: NANOGrav和多个脉冲星计时阵列实验最近报告了随机引力波背景(SGWB)的令人信服的证据。这样的背景可能来源于几个天体物理或宇宙学来源。假设暴胀起源，我们使用最新的NANOGrav 15年数据集来约束暴胀参数，包括张量谱指数($n_t$)、张量标量比($r$)，并通过对再加热状态方程($\omega_{\text{re}}$)和再加热温度($T_{\text{re}}$)的约束来探索对再加热的影响。我们发现偏好极度蓝移的张量谱和非瞬时再加热时期。尽管对原初真空没有具体证据，但暴胀真空通常被认为是Bunch-Davies真空。在这项工作中，我们研究了由双参数Bogoliubov非Bunch-Davies真空族引起的引力波谱的修正。在此框架内，我们发现NANOGrav观测偏好称为alpha真空的非Bunch-Davies真空的子类。此外，我们的分析表明，观测显著缩小了表征真空的参数$α$的范围。我们的分析表明，对于标准Bunch-Davies真空情况，NANOGrav数据可以容纳类似物质和类似辐射的再加热情景。然而，在此考虑的非Bunch-Davies框架内，偏好非类似物质的再加热，因为类似物质的再加热需要相对较大的$α$，违反NANOGrav上限和后反应约束。我们进一步表明，在阈值频率以上，对$α$进行频率依赖的参数化可以产生一个最小解，缓解蓝移问题。最后，我们强调了通过未来的引力波实验测试这种$α$频率依赖性的可能性。
